sections.heading: iPod nano (6th generation)
sections.source_text:
Navigation: Multi-Touch display
Capacity: 8 and 16 GB
Model number and date introduced: A1366: September 2010
iPod nano (6th generation) is available in six colours.
iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED Special Edition is available only from the Apple Store, with an 8 GB or 16 GB capacity. Apple contributes a portion of each iPod nano (PRODUCT) RED Special Edition purchase to the Global Fund to fight HIV/AIDS in Africa.
